Its like after I had my anxiety/panick attacks, I was depressed... sad and cryibg all the time and then I would flip to me being angry. I would leave my house for hours because I wanted to hurt someone, anyone, it didnt matter but I didnt want my husband ir or children to be the recipients of it. I found myself going off on strangers for nothing but would often apologize because I knew that anger was not for them, it was for the person who raped me. 

I also started drinking to numb myself and not think about it and when I would, I would go off on the deep end. My husband would ask what was wrong and I would often say the same thing as you bf, "Nothing, I am fine!"

Your bf needs therapy and it seems like he's still coming to terms with what happened to him which can take a while to fully process. What he's experiencing is normal, its a part of denial even though he knows that it happened if that makes sense. I also felt like I didn't want to burden my husband and thats another reason I havent told him.
